paper_id: CodePAD_ Sequence-based Code Generation with Pushdown Automaton
title: CodePAD: Sequence-based Code Generation with Pushdown Automaton
motivation: 序列到序列代码生成无法保证语法正确性，阻碍生成代码的可用性
problem_framing: 将代码生成形式化为PDA可识别语言约束下的序列生成问题
key_insight: 编程语言是PDA可识别语言的子集，利用PDA状态约束token候选集可确保语法正确
method_signature: PDA模块+状态表示+状态预测任务+联合预测约束生成过程
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: PDA需为每种编程语言单独构建，且仅保证语法正确不保证编译正确
evidence_for_taste: most sequence-based approaches generate codes with no guarantee of grammatical correctness
PDA module is the most critical part of CodePAD
pre-training models have the ability to answer questions, but do not know how to organize them into well-formed codes
GC is the foundation of compilation
thinking_moves: 发现现有序列方法忽视语法约束的根本问题
将编程语言形式化为PDA可识别语言
从解析器工作原理获得启发，设计PDA模块约束生成
通过消融实验验证各组件贡献度
把PDA状态信息作为辅助学习信号引入神经网络
